mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO stocks (stock_code, corp_code, stock_name, market, sector) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{corpCode}, #{stockName}, #{market}, #{sector})
INSERT INTO stock_info (stock_code, sector, intro) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{sector}, #{intro}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sector = #{sector}, intro = #{intro}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT sector FROM stocks WHERE sector IS NOT NULL AND sector != '' ORDER BY sector
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_info SET market_cap = #{marketCap}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode}
